author: Wolfgang Sander
text:
Tap on the "I" icon, "Sensor error" does not automatically mean that  the sensor is defect.
The message "Sensor error" / "measure again in 10 minutes" comes because implausible values have been measured (e.g. rapid up and down of measured values or with a very steep rise / fall in values), Libre app/reader then cannot convert the confusing raw sensor value into a blood glucose value. For security then the possibly false value is not displayed. It's like a safety state. 

Some sensors also deliver very discontinuous values at the beginning, which Libre app/reader then leads on to safety state "measure again in 10 minutes".
Be patient and wait and measure/scan with Libre app also every few minutes.

Abbott requires that you remain in this state for at least 3 hours before the sensor can be exchanged and replaced by Abbott (of course you can measure/scan more often than every 10 minutes).

To prevent this problem one can usually place a new sensor 24 hours before the old one stops but do not activate it.
Start new sensor with Libre app or reader after the old sensor stopped. Like this Libre app usually works from the start.
